proposals.before: Xiangzhou military commissioner Kong remained acting Grand Tutor, co-equal chief minister, and Xiangzhou military commissioner as before.
proposals.after: Xiangzhou military commissioner Kong Qing remained acting Grand Tutor, co-equal chief minister, and Xiangzhou military commissioner as before.
proposals.reason: The surname-only 孔 is Kong Qing: his biography in Jiu Wudai Shi 64 records the same Xiangzhou command before his subsequent Luzhou, Zelu, and Heyang appointments. Expanding the English reference disambiguates the person without altering the Chinese source.

proposals.before: Kong of Xiang kept acting Grand Tutor, chancellor, and Xiang commission.
proposals.after: Kong Qing of Xiang kept acting Grand Tutor, chancellor, and Xiang commission.
proposals.reason: The office sequence identifies 孔 as Kong Qing, whose biography records his Xiangzhou military governorship. The full English name makes the reference intelligible.
